subject: Next steps: technical deep-dive & runbook alignment
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@cloudridge.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: James Walters <james.walters@cloudridge.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery notes & next step request

Hi Vivek —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap from our side so we have alignment before scheduling the deeper session:
- Primary goals: consistent 99th percentile latency for short chat use-cases, lower per-token cost for vector search augmentation, and VPC-isolated deployment for PHI-sensitive workflows.
- Key constraints: our infra team is only available windows in the PST morning (08:00–11:30) or late afternoons (16:00–18:00).
- Compliance: SOC2 + tighter data retention policies — we’ll bring our security lead if needed.

We want to move to a technical deep-dive (60–90m) that includes our ML infra and platform engineers. Can your team propose 2–3 slots next week and a short draft agenda? Also let us know which Redwood engineers you’d expect on the call (runtime/serving, model ops).

Attaching the discovery notes from our side for context (summary).

Thanks,
Elena Park
Head of Platform Engineering
CloudRidge
[Attachment: CR-discovery-notes.pdf (pdf)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@cloudridge.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery notes & next step request

Elena —

Appreciate the succinct recap and the constraints. We can definitely run a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive focused on production serving and the integration path for a VPC/private deployment. Proposed attendees from our side: myself (solutions + architecture), Grace O'Connor (serving/runtime lead), Ben Carter (MLops & deployment).

Draft agenda (we’ll refine after you confirm):
1) 5m quick intros + success criteria refresh
2) 15m environment & constraints (CloudRidge infra + security ask)
3) 30–45m serving runtime deep-dive (batching, KV cache, quantization tradeoffs)
4) 15m deployment path & routing/fallback options (hosted -> dedicated -> private)
5) 10m mutual action plan & next steps (MVP scope + owners)

Slots I can offer in your PST windows next week: 
- Tue 2027-05-25 09:00–10:30 PT
- Wed 2027-05-26 08:30–10:00 PT
- Thu 2027-05-27 16:00–17:30 PT

Please let us know which of these works for your infra and security leads, and if you want any extra deep-dive focus (e.g., embeddings cost profile, quantized-llm accuracy regression examples). I’ve attached a quick TDX agenda PDF we typically use — we can tweak it.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: TDX-Agenda-v2.pdf (pdf)]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Elena Park <elena@cloudridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery notes & next step request

Looping in with a quick note — I’ll lead the runtime deep-dive portion. If you confirm the Tue or Wed morning slot I’ll bring two infra engineers (one focused on kernel/quant ops, one on autoscaling/batching).

Small ask for agenda tweak: add a 10-minute slot for "failure modes & graceful degradation" — we find that’s usually a high-value discussion when customers talk about mixed criticality traffic.

Grace O'Connor
Head of Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
